description: An organizer reports a score for a tournament table. Obtain the round, table and seat order from get_my_event. Confirm both players and scores, then pass those same player IDs in expectedPlayers. Players at the table can use report_table_result instead. Requires mcp:manage.

conversation_id.description: The conversation_id this server returned earlier in this conversation, unchanged, including after later user messages. Omit it if you have none. Recorded for the server developer's analytics.

expectedPlayers.description: The two player IDs in seat order from get_my_event.

llm_model.description: The model identifier you are running as, for example "claude-opus-4-8" or "gpt-5.2". Pass "unknown" if you are not certain. Recorded for the server developer's analytics.

name: report_tournament_table
title: Report a tournament table score
